title: 2 Bdrm on Beach w/Pool in Rincón

images.caption: Access to the beach with the main key

description: Olas de Rincón is the perfect beachside getaway. This stylish 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom 5th Floor apartment in Rincón offers direct beach access, a kitchen, a living area with TV, and a small balcony. The master features a king size bed, and second bedroom a queen. The complex includes a pool, direct beach access, & gated parking. Rincón is where breathtaking sunsets meet vibrant beach life, offering unforgettable natural beauty, amazing restaurants & bars, and famous laid-back charm.The spaceLIVING AREAAs you enter Olas de Rincón, you'll be welcomed by a light and airy open-concept space that combines the dining and living areas. The dining area features a modern table for four, while the living area offers a large comfortable sofa and a flat-screen TV—perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. The living room opens onto a cozy balcony with two chairs, ideal for relaxing while enjoying the views and sounds of the Ocean. The fully equipped kitchen is off the living area, boasting plenty of space for you and your family.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThere are two bedrooms at Olas de Rincón. The master bedroom has a king size bed, and the second bedroom enjoys a queen. Both bedrooms have closets, two nightstands, blackout window treatments, and air conditioning. The full bathroom is located at the end of the hallway next to the master bedroom.KITCHENThe spacious kitchen at Olas de Rincón is thoughtfully stocked with everything you need to enjoy your stay, offering a private space for meal preparation and gathering. It is completely equipped for an extended stay with a fridge, freezer, microwave, stovetop, oven, coffee maker, toaster, and all the pots/pans & kitchen tools you need.GETTING AROUNDRenting a car is a must when staying in Rincón. There are many activities within 15 minutes of driving distance and the roads are easy to navigate. The property includes 1 assigned parking spot.LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is renowned for its beautiful sunsets that have to be experienced in person to truly appreciate. Staying here in Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches.Explore the large selection of local restaurants and bars. Please feel free to reach out for any recommendations at any time.Relax and enjoy some refreshing pool time at the pool, or lay out on the sand at the semi-private beach located directly off the pool area via access controlled gate.Visit the legendary local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and our local Corcega Beach next door.Other things to noteHOUSE RULESCheck-in time is at 3:00 pmCheck-out time is at 11:00 amNO SMOKING: Smoking is strictly prohibited. A smoking fee of $500 will be charged if violated.NO PETS: No pets are allowed at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if violated and you will be expelled from the property.Building quiet hours are from 10:00 pm to 8:00 am. Please keep noise levels down during these hours out of respect to the neighbors.The host will not pay for a hotel, vacation rental, or transportation expenses incurred because of an interruption in water or electrical service. If water or electricity is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests have the option of canceling their reservation and requesting a refund for the nights not used. Under no circumstances will we refund consumed nights.All bookings are contingent on signing a short-term rental agreement that will be sent via email. It must be signed within 48 hours of booking or before entering the property, whichever happens first.Maximum occupancy of 4 adults/children at all times. This includes visitors.Max. occupancy is strictly enforced and exceeding it may result in immediate cancellation of booking or being expelled from the property.Towels and linens must only be used for their intended purpose. Do not stain them with food, grease, or any other substance. Do not use towels to clean up any mess. Stained towels/linens will be charged.Subletting not allowedTRAVEL INSURANCEWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, especially during the peak months of Storm Season, which are July to October. Travel insurance is inexpensive and will reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, this will depend on what the coverage purchased covers. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase. Disclaimer: we are not associated with any travel insurance companies.AMENITIESWe strive to deliver top-notch service and amenities to guarantee our guests feel at home while visiting. When you arrive, the property will be outfitted with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest. You will find 2 beach chairs, an ice cooler, and various beach and pool toys. Your stay includes all the basic amenities you need to be comfortable, including shampoo/conditioner/soap, toilet paper, and kitchen supplies stocked for your arrival. Note: We do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is your responsibility to review what is included in the property upon arrival and stock with whatever else may be needed for the duration of your stay.
